limitations: The result assumes independent Gamma summands with positive shapes and scales. It proves a Laplace-transform gap and smooth-metric lower certificates, not stochastic order or an optimal Kolmogorov lower bound. Full text of Covo–Elalouf (2014) remained inaccessible during the literature comparison.
provenance: Scientific record with cited sources, reproducibility evidence where present, and a dated scientific audit.
